what: crates/hir-def/src/nameres/demand.rs crate_body_owners (line 120) and every_body (177) grow their Vec by push from empty, so a crate of n bodies reallocates each ~log2(n) times. blaze-diagnostics lints::bodies::tests::late_passes_per_crate (the late passes allocate the same at 4 bodies as at 64) fails: 10 allocations at 4 bodies, 19 at 64. Fix: every_body takes `let roots = crate_body_owners(db, krate); let mut bodies = Vec::with_capacity(roots.len());` before walk_bodies; crate_body_owners reserves per module from its scope (e.g. `owners.reserve(scope.declarations().len() + scope.impls().len())`, whatever push_scope_body_owners walks) or counts first, so neither grows with the body count.
